// @control-plane
// RED fixture for `control-plane-pii-free` — the TENANCY ownership slice (P-CP-04 / P-028).
// The lint MUST reject this. A fifth, PII-bearing field has been added to the frozen four-field
// `CrossCellPointer` frame (P-CP-02 / P-027): `region_of_birth` is classified `is_personal=true`
// via the GDPR `#[personal_data(...)]` classify-derive (the generated data-map, contract 10.2).
//
// CRUCIAL — this proves the DATA-MAP LEG, the genuinely-new P-CP-04 property: the field name
// `region_of_birth` is NOT in the name-fingerprint list (it is not `name`/`email`/`body`/…), so
// the substrate name-fingerprint leg alone would MISS it. It is caught ONLY because the data-map
// classifies it `is_personal=true`. No control-plane registry column may be `is_personal=true`
// (refined-arch tenancy §4.3). Tagging does NOT make PII admissible on the control plane — it
// makes the leak machine-detectable; PII is born inside the cell, never here (ADR-11.4/OQ-I).
pub struct CrossCellPointer {
    subject: OpaqueSubjectId,
    #[serde(rename = "type")]
    r#type: ArtifactType,
    correlation_id: CorrelationId,
    home_cell: CellId,
    #[personal_data(special)]
    region_of_birth: String,
}
